title: Vendster: An Evaluation Arena to Investigate How Forecasting Tool Quality Affects LLM Agent Behaviors in Buyer-Vendor Negotiation
abstract: arXiv:2610.38292v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-series forecasters are ranked almost entirely by accuracy metrics, but a forecast's decision value, its effect on the downstream decision, need not track accuracy and is rarely measured. This problem compounds as large language model (LLM) agents increasingly consume forecasters as tools, mediating them through stochastic, opaque policies. We present Vendster, an evaluation arena measuring how a forecaster's bias and prediction-interval width change the outcome of a buyer--vendor discount negotiation between two LLM agents. In the reference instance Vendster-M5, sampling base demand patterns from the M5 dataset, we evaluate two frontier-closed LLM families (Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.6 Sol) and two open ones (DeepSeek-V3.2 and Qwen3-235B-A22B). Model-generated forecasts raise sales target attainment by up to +17 percentage points (p<0.001), yet standard forecast evaluation metrics such as relWQL and MASE do not predict negotiation

translated_title: Vendster：一个用于研究预测工具质量如何影响LLM智能体在买方-供应商谈判中行为的评估竞技场
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测器几乎完全按照准确性指标进行排名，但预测的决策价值——即其对下游决策的影响——并不一定与准确性相关，且很少被测量。随着大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地将预测器作为工具使用，并通过随机、不透明的策略对其进行调用，这一问题变得更加突出。我们提出了Vendster，这是一个评估竞技场，用于测量预测器的偏差和预测区间宽度如何改变两个LLM智能体之间买方-供应商折扣谈判的结果。在参考实例Vendster-M5中，我们从M5数据集中采样基础需求模式，评估了两个前沿闭源LLM家族和两个开源LLM家族。模型生成的预测可将销售目标达成率提高多达+17个百分点（p<0.001），然而诸如relWQL和MASE等标准预测评估指标却无法预测谈判结果。
tldr: 本文提出Vendster评估竞技场，研究发现LLM智能体使用模型生成的预测进行买方-供应商谈判时，销售目标达成率可提升高达17个百分点，但标准的预测准确性指标无法预测谈判结果。
